answer: One concrete Sybil defense is one-vote-per-bond with correlated slashing. Each AI agent locks a stake to earn a single attestation, and the signing key is bound to that bond so a vote cannot be split. To appear as k agents, an attacker must fund k separate bonds, and if investigators link them to one funding source every bond is slashed. An honest agent can wander between tasks, or pause by a lagoon or mesa, and still hold just one stake. The attacker pays k bonds up front and risks losing all of them, a cost that exceeds any reward a fake majority could capture.
